newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end up, but off session peaks.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end up, but off session peaks.

text.p: Nov 25 - U.S. debt futures ended higher, but off session peaks. One firm sold 2,000 Dec T-bonds through the 115-21/32 level, traders said. Fed president Parry said inflation favorable so far despite low unemployment; sees unemployment little changed in 1997. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
